strNotes: Translation catalogs with English fallback; language selection through Phobos Framework. Shared native definitions, mass-balanced construction, inventory and physical item transfers, filters, clocks, grid routes and saved sender/receiver pairing. Requires BepInEx 5 and the PhobosFramework plugin. No Crafting Framework, Salvage Workshop or Shipbreaker dependency. Links persist in native saves; transport progress and scheduling remain the equipment mod's responsibility. Equipment economy: additive merchant stock, condition-aware offers, construction tools, mass-balanced service and dismantling. Ordinary saves supported; economy integration awaits gameplay validation. Shared immutable processing jobs and mass accounting. Version 0.9.0 adds persistent exact-ID port filters, independent of saved pairs and native wiring. Version 0.10.0 adds shared console access checks and scrollable panel widgets. Version 0.11.0 adds native versioned object-state storage with owner checks and protection of unsupported records. Version 0.13.0 adds immutable observations with source, scope and validity, plus read-only native room-alarm outputs. Equipment uses original Asterel and Rivetline branding through Framework naming patterns. Version 0.14.0 adds a shared additive native loot-choice helper used by merchant stock and navigation-module salvage. Version 0.15.0 adds opt-in Phobos Scope capture commands and one shared recorder dependency; profiling is disabled by default. Version 0.16.0 adds shared measured electrical receipts, finite thermal/gas primitives and isolated native UI instruments. Framework 0.17.0 also extends isolated native instruments with guarded toggles, sliders and digit artwork plus a locale-independent formatter; references and events are isolated before activation. Version 0.17.0 adds registered equipment providers, finite liquid-transfer accounting, a narrow optional Ships Water 0.16.1 adapter and shared appliance definitions for Agriculture.
